extracted.intended_audience: kidney health professionals, researchers, and clinical investigators
extracted.subtask_description: Overview/landing page describing National Kidney Foundation research-related resources: grants & funding, patient-researcher connectivity, innovation fund, clinical practice guidelines, and clinical trial information for patients. Intended to direct professionals and stakeholders to program pages with eligibility, guidance, and participation opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants & Funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Access information on NKF’s Research Grant Program, including available grants, funding cycle, eligibility requirements and application instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Navigate to the Research Grant Program page for details on specific grant opportunities, cycles, eligibility criteria, and how to apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Kidney Research Connect
rubrics_metrics.description: Sign up today to find patients and care partners to engage in your patient-centered outcomes research (PCOR) projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Kidney Research Connect to identify and recruit patients and care partners for PCOR; sign-up required to participate.

rubrics_metrics.name: NKF Innovation Fund
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about our game changing impact investment initiative aimed at fundamentally disrupting the fight against chronic kidney disease.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Innovation Fund is an impact investment initiative intended to fund research, technology, and initiatives that transform kidney health (e.g., early detection, treatment improvements, expanding transplant access).

rubrics_metrics.name: KDOQI Clinical Practice Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: World renown for improving the diagnosis and treatment of kidney disease, these guidelines have changed the practices of healthcare professionals and improved thousands of lives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to KDOQI guidelines for evidence-based standards of care and for shaping research questions or clinical practice changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Trial Information for Patients — What is a clinical trial?
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn more about how clinical trials can affect new treatment options in patients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides patient-facing explanations of clinical trials and their role in developing new treatments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Trial Information for Patients — Are clinical trials safe?
rubrics_metrics.description: Clinical studies in the United States are regulated by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). Learn more about safety.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains regulatory protections and safety considerations for patients considering trial participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Trial Information for Patients — How can I find a clinical trial?
rubrics_metrics.description: Interested in participating? Find clinical trials in your area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directs patients and caregivers to resources for locating trials geographically and by condition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Help Shape KDOQI
rubrics_metrics.description: Help us identify future Kidney Disease Outcomes Quality Initiative controversies topics by completing this poll.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stakeholders and professionals can provide input via the poll to influence future KDOQI guideline topics.
